subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
7.
Mr. E, an Articled Clerk, was not sure about which items should be considered
as intangible assets in PQ Ltd. According to AS-26, which of the following
items should not be recognized as intangible assets?
(I)  Internally generated Goodwill
(II)  Compact disk in the case of computer software
(III)  Copyrights
(IV)  Computer software for computer-controlled machine tools that cannot
operate without that specific software, which is an integral part of the
related hardware.
(A)  I & II above
(B)  II & III above
(C)  III & IV above
(D)  I & IV above
(2 Marks)

38
